note: Both sets read the same five spanwise curves and share several flaws: relative thickness 95% at r/R=0 (curve starts at 100%), twist -1.5 deg at r/R=1.0 (curve ends near -1 deg), a 22% thickness claim whose quote cites '20 ... 0.7', and duplicated twist -2 deg at 0.85. Set A adds extra errors: relative thickness 20% at r/R=0 (clearly wrong), a conflicting pitch-axis value of 38% at r/R=1.0 alongside 37%, and a conflicting chord of 1.5 m at r/R=1.0 alongside 0.5 m, plus a duplicate prebend -4 m claim. Set B's unique problems are milder: a duplicated chord 5.7 m at ~0.25 and pitch-axis 50% at 0.0, and a conflicting chord 0.6 m at r/R=1.0, while it correctly adds prebend 0 m at r/R=0 and thickness 20% at the tip. Overall B binds values to the right properties and stations with fewer outright misreads.
